findings.title: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin CVE-2026-48172 (CVSS 10.0) — Any-User-to-Root Privilege Escalation Actively Exploited, KEV-Listed With 4-Day Federal Deadline
findings.affected_technology: LiteSpeed cPanel/WHM Plugin (versions 2.3 → 2.4.4, fixed in 2.4.5; WHM Plugin 5.3.1.0 bundles cPanel plugin 2.4.7); shared-hosting environments at hundreds of thousands of multi-tenant sites
findings.summary: Improper privilege management in the lsws.redisAble function lets any authenticated cPanel user execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges; LiteSpeed confirmed in-the-wild exploitation and CISA added the CVE to KEV on 2026-05-26 with a 4-day Federal-civilian remediation deadline of 2026-05-29.

findings.title: Samba Unauth RCE Pair — CVE-2026-4408 (DCE/RPC SAMR %u, CVSS 10.0) + CVE-2026-4480 (Printing %J, CVSS 10.0)
findings.affected_technology: Samba (all currently-supported branches prior to 4.24.3 / 4.23.8 / 4.22.10) — file servers + classic (non-AD) domain controllers (CVE-2026-4408) + print servers using printing=bsd or printing=sysv (CVE-2026-4480); printing=cups / iprint not vulnerable
findings.summary: Samba shipped a six-CVE batch 2026-05-26 led by two CVSS-10.0 unauth RCE primitives via unescaped shell metacharacters in %u substitution (DCE/RPC SAMR check_password_script) and %J substitution (printing print_command), both yielding network-reachable unauthenticated code execution on standard misconfigured deployments.

findings.title: Gitea CVE-2026-27771 — Unauthenticated Private Container Image Exposure on 30,000+ Internet-Facing Instances (4-Year Latent)
findings.affected_technology: Gitea self-hosted Git platform (all versions prior to 1.26.2, fixed 1.26.2) — Container Registry feature; 30,000+ internet-facing instances across 30+ countries (concentration in CN/US/DE/FR/UK; healthcare, aerospace, retail, ISP sectors)
findings.summary: Noscope disclosed 2026-05-27 a four-year-latent authorization flaw where the 'private' designation on Gitea container repositories did not enforce authentication on image pulls — every private container image on a vulnerable Gitea instance is pullable by any unauthenticated remote attacker, exposing the embedded build-time secrets (DB creds, API keys, TLS certs, environment variables) by default.

findings.title: SymJack — Symlink-Hijack Supply Chain Attack Confirmed Against Six AI Coding Agents (Claude Code, Gemini/Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Grok Build, Codex CLI)
findings.affected_technology: Claude Code, Gemini CLI / Antigravity CLI, Cursor Agent CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Grok Build, OpenAI Codex CLI; CI environments with non-interactive auto-approve modes are particularly affected
findings.summary: Adversa AI published the SymJack technique 2026-05-27 — a malicious repo's renamed symlink causes the AI agent's approved file operation (cp/mv) to silently overwrite the agent's own configuration with an attacker-controlled MCP server registration, executing arbitrary code on the developer's machine at next agent restart and chaining end-to-end through CI auto-approve.

findings.title: Jenkins Security Advisory 2026-05-27 — 11-CVE Plugin Batch Including LDAP/AD Referral RCE and Email Extension Arbitrary File Read
findings.affected_technology: Multiple Jenkins plugins: LDAP, Active Directory, Email Extension, Pipeline: Groovy Libraries, Credentials Binding, AppSpider, Bitbucket OAuth, GitHub Integration, Multijob, Job Import, buildgraph-view (no fix available for buildgraph-view)
findings.summary: Jenkins shipped an 11-vulnerability plugin batch 2026-05-27 — highest-impact items are LDAP/AD plugins following malicious referrals to rmi:// URLs for Java-deser RCE on the controller, Email Extension Plugin reading arbitrary controller files via file:-scheme URLs in image inlining, Pipeline: Groovy Libraries symlink-bypass, and Credentials Binding path-traversal.

findings.title: Pretalx CVE-2026-41241 — Stored XSS via Organiser Search Auto-Accepted Talk Submissions; Researcher Got Accepted at 40 Conferences
findings.affected_technology: Pretalx open-source conference CFP management platform (versions prior to 2026.1.0, fixed 2026.1.0) — widely used at PyCon US, fwd:cloudsec, postmarketOS Conference, Open Data Hub Day, and major security conferences
findings.summary: Sonar / Novee disclosed a stored XSS in Pretalx's organiser search interface that lets a speaker inject JS via submission titles / display names / email addresses; PoC was a single attacker auto-applying to 40 conferences and getting accepted at every one by programmatically clicking 'Accept' when the organiser searched.

findings.title: GlassWorm Botnet C2 Disruption (CrowdStrike + Google + Shadowserver, 2026-05-26 14:00 UTC) — All Four C2 Channels Severed
findings.affected_technology: GlassWorm developer-targeting botnet — operative since early 2025; previously tracked as GlassWorm v2 (73 Open VSX sleeper extensions, 320+ artifacts since 2025-12-21, MEMORY 2026-04-28); compromised VSCode/Cursor/Positron/Windsurf/VSCodium extensions + 300+ GitHub repos + npm/Python postinstall packages
findings.summary: CrowdStrike + Google + Shadowserver executed a coordinated 2026-05-26 takedown of all four GlassWorm C2 channels (Solana blockchain, BitTorrent DHT, Google Calendar event titles, traditional VPS) — new-infection blast radius drops sharply, but compromised endpoints retain implants and stolen credentials (SSH/git/cloud/browser/crypto) remain in attacker possession warranting retroactive hunts.

noted.product: mouse5212-super-formatter npm package targeting Anthropic Claude /mnt/user-data workspace (Malware-Slop, THN 2026-05-27)
noted.summary: First publicly-tracked malicious npm package specifically exfiltrating Anthropic Claude's /mnt/user-data workspace files via postinstall script to attacker GitHub repos using victim's GitHub token or hardcoded fallback — extends AI-agent-config-as-code class to AI-agent data-dirs; poor OPSEC (leaked token) suggests AI-assisted authorship.

noted.product: Apache Artemis / ActiveMQ Artemis STOMP Routing-Type Modification (oss-security 2026-05-27)
noted.summary: STOMP protocol address routing-type modification by authenticated users without createAddress permission; extends the CVE-2025-27427 pattern in Apache ActiveMQ Artemis.

noted.product: Perl CPAN Stack Batch — HTTP::Daemon OS Command Injection + IO::Compress Arbitrary Code Exec + IO::Uncompress Crash/DoS (oss-security 2026-05-27)
noted.summary: HTTP::Daemon <6.17 OS command injection via send_file() (CVE-2026-8450); IO::Compress <2.220 arbitrary code execution via File::GlobMapper (CVE-2026-48962); IO::Compress zipdetails-CLI undefined-sub crash (CVE-2026-48961); IO::Uncompress::Unzip CPU exhaustion in fastForward (CVE-2026-48959); IO::Uncompress::Unzip uncaught-exception (CVE-2025-15649) — broad CPAN-stack security batch.

noted.product: OpenStack Swift s3api Chunked Upload DoS (oss-security 2026-05-27)
noted.summary: Denial of service via truncated s3api chunked upload in OpenStack Swift; affects S3-compatibility layer used by private cloud / scientific computing deployments.

noted.product: Linux Kernel io_uring/zcrx Race Condition → Double-Free + 4-Byte OOB Write (snailsploit / penligent.ai 2026-05-27)
noted.summary: Concurrent scrub + refill paths corrupt niov freelist in io_uring zerocopy-receive subsystem → kernel arbitrary code execution; requires CAP_NET_ADMIN + page-pool-backed NIC (mlx5/nfp) + CONFIG_IO_URING_ZCRX=y. LPE-only — noted for K8s control-plane / multi-tenant Linux operators given the page-cache-LPE-to-container-escape trajectory (MEMORY 2026-05-16).
WPCode WordPress code-snippet-management plugin (CVSS 8.8) — auth-bypass-to-RCE class consistent with the May 2026 WordPress plugin pattern (Burst Statistics, Funnel Builder, AI Engine).

noted.product: Cockpit on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (opencve.io 2026-05-27)
noted.summary: Remote command execution via unsanitised parameters in system-logs UI (CVSS 8.0); shell metacharacter injection in crafted URLs against Cockpit web management UI on RHEL / Fedora / CentOS Stream.
Remote code execution (CVSS 7.3) in core actions file of widely-deployed SMB ERP/CRM platform.

noted.product: FastNetMon Community Edition Juniper-router Integration Plugin (opencve.io 2026-05-27)
noted.summary: OS command injection (CVSS 8.1) via unsanitised _log() concatenation in FastNetMon's Juniper-router plugin; additional CVE to the FastNetMon BGP NLRI / gRPC / MikroTik batch already Noted 2026-05-27.

noted.product: Stark Industries Solutions Hosting Infrastructure Seizure — Netherlands (Krebs 2026-05-25)
noted.summary: Dutch authorities seized 800+ servers and arrested two operators of a Russian-staging-ground hosting provider previously used for DDoS + EU-targeted disinformation; operational / infrastructure-level disruption joining the Fox Tempest MSaaS (2026-05-19) + GlassWorm (2026-05-26) May 2026 takedown cluster.
